source.title: August 20, 2026 Patch Notes — Cup Extraction Change

findings: The PC update replaced Refined Essence of Emotions with Mirror of Equilibrium for the listed cup-reformed accessories, including all eight bundled Ekleta/Apeiron reforms.
Fused Crystal of Emotions NPC sales and crafting stopped. Owned Fused Crystals and Refined Essences were removed and their materials/Silver refunded.
Lejenti's recurring cup-extraction quest stopped being acceptable and accepted quests were canceled/refunded.
The current client still contains historical identities and old descriptions. Those cannot override the explicit PC removal notice.
implementation: Exact-ID confirmed-removal policy, with August date distinct from January crystal and September Spirit Stone removals.
Both historical references show Removed item and the replacement extraction material, without active uses, recipes or acquisition sources.
Planner targets, Opportunities market/profit/EXP, shared ingredient consumers, inventory choices and market requests use the existing shared exclusion gates.
All eight bundled Ekleta/Apeiron reform source records and the Edania generator use Mirror of Equilibrium with the August source provenance.
The eight existing reform formulas, effects, item IDs, historical recipes and synthetic saved quantities remain unchanged.

scope.reason: These two removed-item defects and eight stale extraction instructions were discovered during the continued audit, not separate original 3880 flags.

verification.retainedInitialFailure: A stale exact-icon-count assertion from the previous Scorched Fragment artwork addition failed. Corrected counts to450/614/3467 with explicit shared Scorched identity checks. All seven full test files rerun; no golden/production behavior relaxed.
verification.limits: Confirmed removals and extraction replacement only. Not all remaining processing relationships or source completeness. No personal data, install, visible launch or publication.
